newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi meets Fazio, Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi meets Fazio, Ciampi.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi and Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi held talks with Bank of Italy Governor Antonio Fazio on Sunday, Prodi's office said.
A brief statement gave no details of the talks, which were held a day before Prodi is due to visit Germany.
Prodi will meet the prime minister of Bavaria, Edmund Stoiber, and senior German business leaders and bankers during stops in Munich and Frankfurt.
Prodi made a state visit to Bonn earlier this month, a trip that was dominated by issues of Europe's planned monetary union.
The Italian government has said it is determined to be in the starting line-up for the single currency, scheduled to be launched on January 1, 1999.
